channel.title: BillableCalc Guides
channel.description: Practical guides for freelancers: pricing, contracts, invoices, taxes, plus LinkedIn tips.

item.title: Billable hours and utilization rate for freelancers
item.description: How many hours can a freelancer really bill? Learn to calculate your utilization rate and why it changes the hourly rate you should charge.

item.title: Freelance deposits: how much to ask and how to say it
item.description: Why deposits protect freelancers, how much to ask for, and word-for-word wording to bring it up with a new client.

item.title: Freelance hourly rate formula: how to calculate what to charge
item.description: A simple formula to set your freelance hourly rate: start from the income you want, add taxes and expenses, then divide by the hours you can really bill. Includes worked examples and a free rate calculator.

item.title: How to delete all your LinkedIn posts, comments and likes at once
item.description: LinkedIn has no "delete all" button. Step-by-step guide to removing old posts, comments and reactions by hand, plus a faster way to clean your profile in bulk before a job search.

item.title: How to prevent scope creep as a freelancer
item.description: Scope creep turns profitable projects into unpaid work. Practical habits to stop it politely: written scope, price buffer, change requests and batched feedback.

item.title: How to price a freelance project (fixed price guide)
item.description: Learn how to estimate hours, add a buffer and quote a fixed price without losing money. Step-by-step method with an example and a free project price calculator.

item.title: How to raise your freelance rates without losing clients
item.description: When to raise your freelance rates, how much to ask for and how to tell existing clients. Includes the math showing a raise often pays for itself.

item.title: How to write a freelance contract (what to include)
item.description: The clauses every freelance contract needs, explained in plain language. General information, not legal advice.

item.title: How to write a scope of work (with example)
item.description: A one-page scope of work stops 'I thought that was included' for good. Learn the six parts every freelance scope needs, with a short example you can adapt.

item.title: Late payment email templates for freelancers
item.description: Three copy-and-paste email templates for overdue invoices, from friendly to firm, plus how to calculate late fees. Get paid faster without burning bridges.

item.title: Salary to freelance rate: how to convert your pay
item.description: Why a freelance rate must be much higher than your salary divided by hours, with a step-by-step example and links to free calculators.
